Boys & Girls Clothes

When you're looking for the best kids' clothing at affordable prices, The Children's Place has everything your little ones need for school, play, special occasions and every day in between. From toddler boy, toddler girl and baby clothes to kids accessories, shoes and matching outfits for the whole family, it’s your one-stop shop for styles kids love and parents can count on.

Find mix-and-match essentials for girls, including fun graphic tees, dresses, leggings, jeans, tops, bottoms and more. For boys, shop shirts, sweaters, pants, jackets and comfy everyday outfits made for class, playdates and weekend adventures. Plus, cozy activewear and PJs help keep them ready for downtime, bedtime and everything on the schedule.

As each school year approaches, explore comfortable school uniform styles including polo shirts, chino pants, sweaters, jackets and more to help your child look great and feel even better. Use our store locator to find your nearest The Children’s Place store, or shop online for the latest kids clothes at prices made for growing families.

Whether you're shopping for casual outfits, dressy holiday looks or everyday kids clothing, The Children’s Place has a wide range of sizes, styles and must-have favorites for every child. Outfits styled by mom, looks loved by kids.

Boys' and Girls' Accessories at The Children's Place

For the best in kids accessories, shop The Children's Place for backpacks, shoes, sneakers, hair accessories, rompers and more. Whether you're shopping for girls, boys, toddler clothes or baby clothes, you’ll find the finishing touches they need to complete every outfit with comfort, color and kid-approved style.

Get them ready from head to toe with back to school clothing & accessories made for every part of their day. Shop backpacks for carrying books and supplies, sneakers for recess and after-school fun, hair accessories for neat classroom looks and everyday extras that make school outfits feel complete. From first-day photos to daily school routines, these kid-approved accessories are easy to pair with uniforms, jeans, dresses, leggings, graphic tees and more.

When it’s cold outside, keep them cozy with scarves, mittens, gloves and warm hats made for chilly-day adventures. When the weather warms up, baseball hats, sun hats and lightweight accessories help keep them comfortable while adding a fun finishing touch to their favorite looks.

Baby Clothes and Accessories

For your littlest ones, The Children's Place has sweet and comfy baby clothes and accessories for every moment. Shop tops, jackets, dresses, shoes and more for baby girls, plus baby boy sets and bodysuits with playful prints, soft fabrics and seasonal styles made for cuddles, outings and picture-perfect days.

Unisex pajamas and baby accessories also make thoughtful gifts, with gender-neutral colors and easy-to-love designs parents can use again and again. From everyday essentials to special little extras, you’ll find adorable baby styles made for comfort, convenience and memories in the making.

At The Children's Place, our wide variety of kids shoes includes styles for every season and occasion. Boots and booties are perfect for cooler weather, sandals are great for sunny days, and sneakers are everyday favorites for school, play and weekend fun. Plus, ballet flats, dress shoes and slippers give kids comfy options for special moments and relaxing at home. When you're looking for footwear that’s cute, comfortable and easy to pair with toddler, baby, boys’ or girls’ outfits, head straight to The Children's Place.
